subject: CHEMISTRY
purpose: Require the full instructional spine for every full-learning capability, so Core 1 reads as competitive-study material rather than NCERT summary notes. A page that states the rule and stops is a summary; a page that also reconstructs it, works one out, repairs the likely wrong model and fades support is teaching.

depth_classes.FULL_LEARNING: Every required spine role must be present and must meet its minimum depth.
depth_classes.CONCISE_VERIFY_ONLY: Only the verify-only roles are required; the full re-teach roles are forbidden.
depth_classes.PROBE: Only the probe roles are required; worked example and guided/faded attempts are forbidden.

required_spine_roles.why: The learner needs the rule or model stated in one place they can return to.
The same idea in plain words, before any notation.
required_spine_roles.minimum_words_rationale: Set to block a placeholder, not to mandate a word count. The shortest real plain-language line in the promoted PCK registry is seven words ("Name the evidence before naming the class."), which is terse but complete; raising the floor above it would manufacture a defect rather than find one.

required_spine_roles.why: Competitive depth means the learner can rebuild the result, not just quote it.
One instance carried all the way through with the steps visible.
The likely wrong model is named, contrasted against the right one, repaired and retried.
Practice with the cues still present.
Practice with no cues, which is the exam condition.
An independent check the learner can run on their own answer.
Where the same reasoning is needed next.
The 'if you get stuck' line must produce an observable action; it is governed by the helper-pedagogy profile.

summary_level_indicators: attempts collapse to a single undifferentiated practice prompt
